quests.title: A Way into the Archive
quests.description: An original generic example. Seek permission by either method, then choose to enter the reading room. The closing-hours inquiry is optional.
quests.rewards: Descriptive only: any permission must be granted by a character in the story. Questism does not grant access, items or currency.

stages.title: Find a permitted way inside
stages.description: Either the clerk must actually grant reading-room permission, or an archivist must actually agree to escort you. Asking, planning or assuming consent does not qualify. Learning the closing time is optional and may be left unfinished.

objectives.text: Hear the clerk explicitly grant permission to enter the reading room.
Hear an archivist explicitly agree to escort you into the reading room.
Hear a member of staff state today's closing time.

stages.title: Choose to enter
stages.description: Permission or an escort's agreement does not move the player. Wait for the player's actual action entering the reading room. Do not invent movement to finish the quest.

objectives.text: Enter the reading room after permission has been established.

quests.title: The Archivist's Request
quests.description: An optional follow-up available only after the visit, when an archivist is present to offer it.

giver.name: Archivist
giver.instruction: If willing, ask whether the player would help return a reference volume to the correct shelf. Leave acceptance or refusal to the player. Do not assume the volume has been moved.

quests.rewards: The archivist may express thanks. This is a descriptive promise, not a guaranteed relationship or mechanical reward.

objectives.text: Place the reference volume on the correct shelf after choosing to help.

quests.title: The Lobby Ledger
quests.description: A separate optional task in the lobby, made available after the archive-entry goal was closed. It grants no reading-room permission and does not complete the declined visit.

giver.name: Clerk
giver.instruction: If willing and appropriate in the established scene, offer a small independent task alphabetizing the loose lobby ledger forms. The availability gate is mechanical: do not claim the clerk heard a spoken refusal or knows the player's private thoughts. Do not grant room permission, move the player or decide acceptance. The clerk may defer.

quests.rewards: Descriptive only: the clerk may express thanks in the story. The engine records completion, not inventory, money, access or relationships.

objectives.text: Actually alphabetize the loose lobby ledger forms into the requested order.
